items.title: 0xmrma/CVE-2026-5061
items.description: Consul Template validated where a symlink pointed during template evaluation, but its later dependency fetch read the original path. Retargeting the link between those operations turned an in-sandbox file reference into an out-of-sandbox file disclosure.

technical.summary: A detailed technical writeup describing CVE-2026-5061, a TOCTOU sandbox bypass in HashiCorp Consul Template's file helper. The document explains the root cause, attack chain, and fix, and references a standalone reproducer, but does not include any executable exploit or scanner code.

prerequisites.text: Local filesystem influence to create, replace, or retarget a symlink during the vulnerable window.
Consul Template process must have permission to read the external target file.

behavior.text: The writeup describes a standalone deterministic reproducer that controls the symlink lifecycle to demonstrate the vulnerability, but the reproducer code is not included in the evidence.

The document explains the root cause: sandbox validation resolves the symlink target, but the dependency fetch later uses the original raw path, allowing a retargeted symlink to read an out-of-sandbox file.

items.title: 0xmrma/CVE-2026-14361
items.description: Consul Template's writeToFile helper opened an operator-supplied destination directly and followed linked path components, allowing rendered output to escape the intended directory and overwrite a preexisting file.

technical.summary: A detailed technical writeup describing CVE-2026-14361, a path redirection vulnerability in HashiCorp Consul Template's writeToFile helper. The document explains the root cause, attack chain, proof-of-concept methodology, fix analysis, and disclosure timeline, but does not include executable exploit or scanner code.

prerequisites.text: Local filesystem access to create or modify a symlink, directory junction, or equivalent redirection in or beneath the intended write location.
Consul Template process must write through the attacker-influenced path.

behavior.text: The writeToFile helper opens the user-supplied path directly using os.Create() or os.OpenFile(), following existing symlinks or directory junctions.
A linked parent directory can redirect the actual write outside the intended root while the path string remains under the intended root.
The vulnerability allows overwriting a preexisting file at the resolved destination.
Ownership and permissions are applied using the path again after the write, not the open file descriptor.

technical.summary: A Python script that chains CVE-2025-57819 (unauthenticated stacked SQL injection) and CVE-2025-61678 (authenticated arbitrary file upload) to achieve remote code execution on FreePBX 16. It creates an admin user via SQLi, logs in, uploads a PHP webshell, and executes commands or a reverse shell.

prerequisites.text: Target running vulnerable FreePBX 16 endpoint module
Network access to the FreePBX admin interface

behavior.text: Sends unauthenticated stacked SQL injection payloads to create a new admin user in the ampusers table
Authenticates to the FreePBX admin panel using the injected credentials
Uploads a PHP webshell via path traversal in the fwbrand parameter of the endpoint firmware uploader
Executes arbitrary system commands through the uploaded webshell
Initiates a reverse shell connection to an attacker-controlled host

classification_reason.text: The script actively exploits vulnerabilities to gain unauthorized access and execute code on a target system. It performs SQL injection to create an admin user, authenticates, uploads a webshell, and executes commands or a reverse shell, which constitutes exploitation rather than mere detection or analysis.

backdoor_review.summary: The PoC implements the advertised exploit chain (CVE-2025-57819 SQLi → admin creation → CVE-2025-61678 file upload → webshell → command execution/reverse shell). No concealed backdoor, unrelated payload, credential exfiltration, or persistence mechanism was observed. The code performs only the actions described in its documentation.

observables.context: The PoC uploads a PHP webshell to the target server as part of the documented RCE chain.
The PoC includes standard reverse shell payloads for interactive access, consistent with the documented exploit behavior.
